title: 2025 Topps Series 1 Padres Spring Training Cactus Foilboard #39 SP J. Merril
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2025 Topps Series 1 baseball trading card featuring the San Diego Padres player Jackson Merrill. This specific card is a Spring Training Cactus Foilboard parallel variety, with a short print run indicated by the #39 card number. Manufactured by Topps, this collectible item is part of the 2025 set and showcases a unique design for fans of Major League Baseball looking to add a special piece to their collection.
